tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/khams gsum 'gro ba'i bla ma 'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs kyi gsung rab dpe bsdur ma pod gsum pa bzhugs/ /
༄༅/khams gsum 'gro ba'i bla ma 'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs kyi gsung rab dpe bsdur ma pod gsum pa bzhugs/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ khams gsum 'gro ba'i bla ma 'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs kyi gsung rab dpe bsdur ma pod gsum pa bzhugs/ /

༄༅/ /dpal gshin rje'i gshed dgra nag po'i sgrub pa'i thabs bsdus pa bzhugs so/ / ༄༅/ /dpal gshin rje'i gshed dgra nag po'i sgrub pa'i thabs bsdus pa | bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jam dpal thugs rjes khros pa gshin rje gshed/ /mi bzad khro bo rgya cher rnam rol ba/ /bdud dpung 'joms pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal nas/ /de yi sgrub pa'i man ngag ji bzhin bshad/ /bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing*/ dam tshig dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ gshin rje'i gshed dgra nag po zhal gsum pa'i gtso bo 'ba' zhig gi sgrub pa'i rim pa ni | chos gnyis kyis rtogs par bya ste/ bsnyen pa dang*/ mchod pa'i rim pa'o// dang po la bzhi/ lha'i rnal 'byor/ sngags kyi bzlas pa/ gtor ma'i cho ga yan lag gi bya ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis las/ sngon 'gro tshogs gnyis bsag pa ni | bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song nas/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis gshin rje gshed kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i don du de nyid bsgom snyam pa'i byang chub kyi sems yun ring du bsgom/ de nas skad cig gis rang gshin rje gshed du lhag par mos pa'i snying gar/ pam̐ las pad+ma/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ ya yig sngon po bltas te/ de las byung ba'i 'od zer gy-i snang bas/ rang gi sdig pa dang sgrib pa sbyangs nas/ phyi rol du 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas lha dang bla ma mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs la/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ zhes pas bla ma la phyag 'tshal/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pā da ban+da naṃ ka ro mi/ zhes brjod nas/ gshin rje gshed dang sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag bya'o/ /de nas rang gi snying ga nas sprul pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis/ mchod rdzas rnams thogs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ya mān+ta ka sa pa ri wā ra/ zhes kun la sbyar la/ pra wa ra sat+kā ra pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha

(《 zha 》+ ye ) swā hā/ zhes pas zhabs bsil dang*/ pra wa ra sat+kā ra ni ri (《 zha 》 wi t+ya ) āḥhūm̐ swā hās zhal bsil dang*/ pra wa ra sat+kā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha (《 zha 》+ ye ) swā hās mchod yon no// pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ gyis gdan dang*/ badz+ra dhū pe hūm̐ gis spos/ badz+ra puṣ+pe trāṃ gis me tog badz+ra dī pe hrīḥs mar me/ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥs dri/ badz+ra nai wi d+ye hūm̐ gis zhal zas | badz+ra shap+da āḥs rol mo rnams phul la/ 'khor gsum mi dmigs pas rgyas gdab bo/ /de nas brjod par 'gyur ba rnams kyi don dran par bya zhing | dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags | | gshin rje gshed po'i dam tshig kun/ /ma lus yongs su bskyang bar bgyi/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rangs/ /rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir | | byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing*/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul | | mya ngan mi 'da' gsol ba 'debs/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas sras bcas kun/ /gshegs shing gshegs dang gshegs 'gyur ba'i/ /sbyin sogs lam gyi rang bzhin gang*/ /ci yod stobs kyis brten par bgyi/ /dge bas 'gro kun bde chen nyid/ /thob pa'i rjes su mthun gyur cig /ces bya ba lan gsum brjod do/ /de nas lha dang bla mas rigs kyi bu shin tu legs so zhes gnang ba byin par bsams nas/ oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes brjod la gshegs su gsol/ de nas tshad med pa bzhi bsgom pa'i phyir/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer dkar po 'phros pas/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad gang nas/ sems can thams cad bde ba la bkod/ yang 'od zer sngon po 'phros pas/ sems can thams cad la phog pas sdug bsngal dang bral bar byas/ yang 'od zer dmar po 'phros | sems can thams cad la phog pas bde ba dang mi 'bral ba'i dga' ba la bkod/ yang 'od zer ljang gu 'phros/ sems can rnams la phog pas chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms tshad med pa la bkod par bsam mo/

/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'o/ /de nas chos thams cad sgyu ma ltar mos la | oṃ swa bhā ba shud+dha s+sarba dharmā swa bhā ∶ ba shud+dho3 ha ཾ(《 zha 》 āt+ma ko3 haṃ ) / zhes brjod do | | de nas sgyu ma tsam du yang mi dmigs pa'i stong par mos la/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod la stong par bsgom mo/ /ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor la gnyis/ rten bskyed pa dang*/ lha bskyed pa'o/ /dang po ni/ stong pa'i ngang las/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje rwa lnga lnga dang ldan pa/ lte ba mthing nag la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa bsam/ de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas | rdo rje sa gzhi/ ra ba/ dra ba/ gur/ bla re/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom/ de'i nang du dhīḥlas byung ba'i chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa phyi dkar nang dmar ba'i nang du/ pam̐ las pad+ma/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du/ mam̐ las ma he rab tu khros pa/ mdog sngon po/ thal chen gyis byugs pa/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ sma ra dang smin ma ser ba/ rwa dang rmig pa rab tu 'bar ba/ mig me mdag gi phung po lta bu/ mgo g.yas su bstan pa'i gdan bsam mo/ /rten bskyed pa'o/ /gnyis pa lha bskyed pa la bdun las/ dam tshig pa bskyed pa ni/ gdan gyi steng du/ ya'i yi ge yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje sngon po lte ba la yas mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer phar 'phros | sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ tshur 'dus nas 'dres te yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ sku mdog mthing nag rtsa ba'i zhal gnag pa/ g.yas dkar la g.yon dmar ba/ zhal re re zhing dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing*/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ sma ra dang smin ma ser ba/

g.yas kyi dang po na gri gug g.yon gyi dang po na thod pa khrag gis bkang ba 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na rdo rje/ gsum pa na ral gri 'bar ba/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na 'khor lo/ gsum pa na pad+ma 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum pas ma he'i rwa bar mnan cing*/ g.yon brkyang pas ma he'i tshang rar brdzis pa/ sku sbom zhing thung ba/ gsus khyim rab tu che ba/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ mi mgo skam po lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa ste/ mtha' yas sngon pos dbu skra bcings pa/ 'jog po dmar po'i rna rgyan | rigs ldan khra bo'i dpung rgyan/ dung skyong ser po'i gdub bu/ pad+ma dkar po'i mgul rgyan/ karko ṭa ljang gu'i se ral kha/ nor rgyas dkar po'i ska rags/ pad+ma chen po sngo skyas rkang gdub byas pa/ klu'i rgyal po thams cad kyang spyi bor nor bu rin po ches brgyan cing*/ lce gnyis brkyang nas phud kyi sgra drag tu sgrogs par bsam mo/ /de'i pang na rang snang gi rig ma rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dang phyag mtshan/ rgyan dang cha lugs yab dang 'dra bas 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan zhing*/ ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsam mo/ /de nas oṃ dharma dhā tu swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod la byin gyis brlab bo/ /de'i thugs kar pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du/ ya las byung ba'i ye shes sems dpa' rang ci 'dra ba mtshon gang ba zhig bsam/ de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' rdo rje sngon po lte ba la yas mtshan pa bsam | de las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ snod kyi 'jig rten la phog pas snod thams cad sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnam par dag pa dang*/ pad+ma nyi ma dang ma he'i gdan du gyur/ yang 'od 'phros bcud kyi sems can la phog sems can rnams gshin rje gshed du gyur nas gdan rnams kyi steng du bzhugs par bsam mo/

/'od zer tshur 'dus nas ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' la thim par bsgom mo/ /dam tshig pa bskyed pa'o/ /de nas rang gi dpral bar oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa bsams nas/ de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i rang bzhin du mos la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bhā wa ād+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod do/ /mgrin par āḥlas pad+ma dmar po āḥs mtshan pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi rang bzhin du bsams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wāka badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod do/ /snying gar hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi rang bzhin du mos la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod do/ /de nas skye mched byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir/ mig tu k+ṣe gti mug gshin rje gshed/ rna bar ya zhe sdang gshin rje gshed/ snar ma phra ma gshin rje gshed/ lcer me 'dod chags gshin rje gshed/ dpral bar phrag dog gshin rje gshed/ snying gar hūm̐ rdo rje sems dpa' bsam ste/ yi ge de dag gi rnam pa nyid lha de dag gi ngo bo yin snyam du bsam mo/ /sku gsung thugs dang skye mched byin gyis brlab pa'o/ / de nas yang ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad/ gshin rje gshed rigs lnga dang*/ khro bo dang*/ sems dpa' dang*/ rdo rje lha mo'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba'i rnam par gyur nas | mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su spyan drangs la/ snga ma ltar mchod nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing*/ ye shes kyi chus gang ba'i bum pas spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ khro bos bgegs bskrad/ sems dpas bkra shis brjod/ lha mo rnams kyis

mchod par bsam/ dbang bskur ba'i chu rgyun des rkang mthil yan chad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag dbang bzhi thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ dbang bskur ba'o/ /de nas yang dbang bskur gyi lha de dag nyid ye shes par bltas la/ snga ma bzhin du mchod nas/ ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' las 'od zer tho ba dang*/ dbyug to dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ ral gri'i rnam pa spros la/ lha rnams la reg pas/ rkyen byas nas rang dang gnyis su med par bstim par bsam zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra mut+ka ra dzaḥ oṃ daṇ+ḍa hūm̐/ oṃ pad+ma baṃ/ oṃ khaḍ+ga hoḥ zhes brjod do/ /ye shes pa bstim pa'o/ /de nas bdud rtsi myang ba'i don du/ dngos su chang la bdud rtsi sbyar ba yod na de la dmigs shing*/ med na yang bsams la/ gtor ma bzhin byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang gi lce las 'od kyi sbu gu byung ba'i nang nas drangs te/ myangs pas lus thams cad gang nas bde ba rgyas par bsam zhing*/ dngos su yod na yang myangs la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mri ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod la byin gyis brlab bo/ /bdud rtsi myang ba'o | | de nas mchod pa'i don du yab yum gnyis snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba'i sgras/ sangs rgyas thams cad bskul/ zhal du zhugs/ snying gar zhu/ yum gyi mkhar babs pas/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams su gyur/ de rnams spros nas/ dpag tu med par gyur pas bdag dang rang bzhin gyi lha dang*/ snod bcud kyi lha rnams mchod par bsam zhing*/ gong du brjod pa'i sngags rnams kyis dbul lo | | oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra sa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pas byin gyis brlab bo/ /mchod pa'o/ /de nas lha mo de dag nyid kyis bstod par bsam zhing | 'di skad ces brjod do/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin khyod/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni kun sdud cing*/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mchog gi mchog /dkyil 'khor bdag por phyag 'tshal bstod/

/ces bstod nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu ti badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pas byin gyis brlab bo/ /bstod pa'o// de nas lha'i rnam pa de dag snang la rang bzhin med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar dmigs la yid mnyam par bzhag go /lha'i rnal 'byor ro/ /gnyis pa sngags kyi bzlas pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' yi ge hūm̐ gi mtha' mar/ sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba la dmigs nas bzlas pa'i tshe/ sngags las sngags kyi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi rgyud bskul nas/ ye shes pa bdag la bstim pa dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi don byed pa'i las gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus nas sngags rnams la thim | de lta bu'i spro bsdu la dmigs la sngags bzla'o/ /sngags kyi tshig ni 'di dag yin te/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+t+rīḥwi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bya ba'o/ /bsnyen pa'i tshad ni 'bum phrag bcu bzhi yin la/ bye ba phrag lnga bzlas na dngos grub rnams 'byung zhing*/ las rnams sgrub pa la thogs pa med do/ /zhes gsungs so// sngags kyi bzlas pa'o/ /gsum pa gtor ma'i cho ga ni/ sha dang khrag gis brgyan pa'i gtor ma chang dang chus sbyangs la/ yi ge bcu bzhi pa'i sngags kyis bsangs shing | swa bhā bas stong par bsgoms pa'i ngang nas/ kam̐ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi dbus su/ yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me/ sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du āḥ las thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa/ de'i dbus su ya las byang chub kyi sems | shar du k+ṣe las dri chen/ lhor ma las dri chu/ nub tu me las sha chen/ byang du da las rak+ta/ yang dbus su ma las mi'i sha shar lhor ha las glang po che'i sha lho nub tu a las rta'i sha nub byang du go las ba lang gi sha byang shar du ku las khyi'i sha de thams cad kyi steng du/ oṃ dkar po mgo thur du lta ba/ de'i steng du zla ba la gnas pa'i rdo rje dkar po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa bsam/

hūm̐ las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga 'od du zhu/ rlangs pa/ oṃ la phog pas bdud rtsi'i rgyun zags/ rdo rje la phog pas lte ba'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bdud rtsi bkug rdo rje la thim/ rdo rje zla ba oṃ dang bcas pa thur du lhung bas rdzas thams cad 'dres te zhu nas/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsgoms la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang gi snying ga'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas gshin rje gshed steng gi cha la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor zhing*/ 'og gi cha las 'jig rten skyong ba bcu bzhi/ 'jig rten pa'i 'khor gyis bskor ba spyan drangs par bsam zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes brjod nas/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya byas la/ pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ gyis so so la gdan dbul/ de nas de rnams kyi zhal nas 'od kyi sbu gu byung nas gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+t+rī:wi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ i daṃ ba liṃ bhak+ṣa ya bhak+ṣa ya hi hi hi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaiṃ phaiṃ swā hā/ zhes lan bdun gyis dbul

| gong du bstan pa bzhin mchod pas mchod/ gshin rje gshed po rab 'jigs pa/ /la sogs pas bstod nas/ gshin rje gshed po 'khor bcas kun | | mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ /dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang | | longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*/ /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ / las kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /dkon mchog gsum la smod pa dang*/ / dam pa'i chos ni 'jig pa dang*/ /dge 'dun 'du ba'i sgo 'phrog dang*/ /'gro yongs 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs 'di/ /ngan song gsum du mngon par 'gro/ / thugs rjes bsgral ba'i dus la bab/ /nad dang gnod pa sdug bsngal las/ /tshe 'di nyid la bral bar mdzod/ /ces phrin las bcol pas lha rnams kyis ha ha (《 lu 》+ ho ho ) hi hi hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing mnyes nas dngos grub stsal bar bsam/ de nas bzod par gsol te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ muḥ zhes brjod la gshegs su gsol lo | | gtor ma dben pa'i sar dor ro/ /gtor ma'i cho ga'o/ /bzhi pa yan lag gi bya ba la bzhi las/ nyal ba'i tshe ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' las 'od 'phros pas/ snod bcud dang 'khor 'das rnams rang la bsdu/ gdan sku la bsdu | sku ye shes sems dpa' la bsdu/ de ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' la bsdu/ rdo rje ya la bsdu/ ya mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang la nyal lo/ /nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ro/ /nangs par ldang ba'i tshe/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis rang gi sems ya'i yi ger gyur/ de zhu ba las gshin rje gshed kyi skur gyur/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas/ 'khor 'das dang snod bcud rnams gsal bar bkod la lhar blta'o/ /ldang ba'i rnal 'byor ro/ kha zas za ba'i tshe kha zas gtor ma ltar bsangs shing sbyangs la/ snod āḥlas thod par bskyed pa'i nang du | bcud oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis ye shes kyi bdud rtsir bskyed nas/ rang gi lus gshin rje gshed dang*/

snying gar 'das pa'i lha tshogs dang*/ lto bar 'jig rten pa'i lha tshogs rnams bsams la/ de rnams mchod pa'i bsam pas bza' bar bya'o | | lhag ma rnams lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po la sbyin no/ kha zas kyi rnal 'byor ro/ /de nas spyod lam sna tshogs la 'jug pa'i tshe/ rang lha'i skur gsal bar dmigs la/ dag pa dran par bya ste/ 'di skad ces/ sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa/ /bcom ldan 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid ni/ /thugs rjes gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyir/ khro bor gyur pa gshin rje gshed/ /sku dang rnam thar rdo rje'i zhal/ /rig pa gsum gyi spyan mnga' zhing*/ /dbyings dang ye shes pha rol phyin/ /mngon par shes pa drug gi phyag /thabs dang shes rab rol pa yi | | zhabs gnyis bskum dang brkyang ba yis/ /ma he gshin rje srid pa yi/ /rtsa ba rtsad nas 'joms phyir gnon/ /sdug bsdul gcod phyir gri gug ste/ /bde ba skyong bas thod khrag rol/ /dbyings dang ro gcig phyag rgya che/ /stong nyid rdo rje phyag gis bsnams/ /shes rab ral gri 'debs pa'i tshul/ /'khor lo chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /thugs rje rnam rgyas pad+mo 'dzin/ /zung 'jug bde dang rtag rol pas/ /nyid sku khro mos nye bar brgyan/ /gnyis ka'ang sgeg dang rgod pa dang | | snying rjes chags can sdud phyir brtse/ /g.yon pa'i zhal yang ches cher dmar | | rtsa zhal sku mdog mthing nag dang*/ /dpa' dang drag shul rngam pa yis/ khro ba'i khro ba 'joms phyir khro/ /mi sdug 'jigs rung zhi ba dang*/ /g.yas zhal dkar zhing gsal ba yis/ /gti mug can gyi rmongs pas sel/ /yon tan rgyas pas dbu skyes ser/ /mthu stobs 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs/ /zhes brjod cing | don dran par byas la/ ji ltar bdag nyid de ltar gzhan/ /thams cad dpal chen gshin rje gshed/ /rang bzhin med pa'i rang bzhin can/ /zung du 'jug pa'i rol pas rol/ /zhes brjod nas/ snang ba thams cad kyang lhar dmigs la kun tu spyod pa thams cad lha'i nga rgyal dang*/

longs spyod pa thams cad lhas lha la mchod par bsam zhing spyad do/ /de'i ngang nas kha ton dang*/ klog pa dang*/ rab gnas dang*/ sbyin sreg la sogs pa'i cho ga rnams kyang bya'o// spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor te yan lag gi cho ga'o/ /de dag gis ni bsnyen pa'i cho ga bstan zin to/ /gang gis go 'phang dam pa la/ /nye bar byin cing rgyal ba yi// byin rlabs nye bar 'gugs byed pas/ /bsnyen pa zhes ni nye bar bsgrags/ /spyi don gnyis pa mchod pa'i cho ga la gnyis/ rgyun du bya ba rgyun bshags dang 'brel pa dang*/ khyad par du bya ba tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga'o/ /phyi ma shes na dang po rtogs sla ba'i phyir tshogs kyi 'khor lo bshad par bya'o/ /de'ang gnas dben par rten dang*/ chu gsum sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa rnam pa lnga dang*/ nang gi mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma gsum dang*/ tshogs kyi yo byad rnams bsogs nas | zhu ba dbul ba dang*/ yi ge brgya pas rgyud sbyang pa byas la/ gong du bstan pa'i tshul gyis lha'i rnal 'byor dang sngags bzlas pa rdzogs par bya'o/ /de nas mchod pa rnams bsangs shing sbyangs nas/ de nyid gsum las grub pa'i lha rdzas kyi mchod rdzas so sor bskyed do/ /de nas rang nyid yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba'i sgras/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams zhal du zhugs/ snying gar zhu/ yum gyi mkhar babs pa mchod pa'i lha mo rnams su gyur nas/ phyir spros pas mchod rdzas rnams thogs nas gnas par bsam mo/ /de nas mdun bskyed ni bris sku la sogs pa yod na de la dmigs pa'i rten bya zhing*/ med na mdun gyi nam mkha' la/ sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi me tog tshom bu la ye shes pa gzhug pa'i bar rang gis bsgoms pa ltar byas la/ de'i steng gi cha la bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa dang*/ 'khor du sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ phyogs skyong ba dang*/ 'jig rten skyong ba rnams kyis bskor bar bsam/

de nas mchod par bya ste/ thog mar phyi'i mchod pa ni ting nge 'dzin dang phyag rgya bcas pas/ dri med gtsang mar sbyar ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i zhabs bsil 'di/ /bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /zhabs dag nye bar bkru bar mdzod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ya mān+ta ka sa pa ri wā ra pra wa ra sat+kā ra pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha (《 zha 》《 lu 》+ ye ) swā hā/ zhes pas zhabs bsil dang*/ de bzhin du zhal bsil 'di dang*/ zhal rnams nye bar bsil bar mdzod/ /ni wi te āḥ hūm̐ | zhes pas zhal bsil dang*/ mchod yon 'di/ ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol | | ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha (《 zha 》《 lu 》+ ye ) swā hā/ zhes pas mchod yon dang*/ lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i bdug spos 'di/ /bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ / ∶ badz+ra (《 lu 》 oṃ ) dhū pe hūm̐/ zhes pas bdug spos dang*/ chu dang thang las skyes pa yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i me tog 'di/ /bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ / bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /badz+ra puṣ+pe trāṃ/ zhes pas me tog dang*// dri med yid 'ong gsal ba yi/ /mar me 'di zhes pa dang*/ badz+ra dī pe hrīḥ zhes pas mar me dang*/ lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba yi/ /dri mchog 'di zhes pa dang*/ gan+dhe āḥzhes pas dri chab dbul/ kha dog ro dang bcud ldan pa'i/ /zhal zas 'di zhes pa dang*/ nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐ gis zhal zas dbul/ zin dang ma zin yid 'ong pa'i/ /sil snyan 'di zhes pa dang*/ oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐ gis sil snyan dbul | de dag ni phyi'i mchod pa'o/ /de nas nang gi mchod pa gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ mthe bong dang srin lag gi thor mas rtsa ba'i bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa la dbul/ de nas yi ge bcu bzhi pa'i sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sbyar bas yi dam gyi lha la dbul/ de nas lce rtse dpral ba mgrin pa snying ga rnams su reg nas rang gi lus kyi lha mchod/

de nas chos skyong dang phyogs skyong la sogs pa rnams la'ang dbul lo/ /nang gi mchod pa'o/ /de nas yid las byung ba'i mchod pa ni gong gi mchod pa'i lha mo de dag gis/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mchod pa'i rnam grangs du mas mchod cing*/ 'di skad ces gsung bar bsam/ kye kye gshin rje dgra nag po/ /bla ma srin po'i gzugs rang bzhin/ khyod mthong bas ni bdag 'jigs te/ /bla ma khro bo'i rang bzhin spongs/ /bdag po yis ni gar mdzad pas/ /steng ris mi yul sa 'og 'dar | khro yid mig sman bcag 'dra ba'i/ /gar byed khyod ni rnam mi rtog / gshin rje'i dgra nag mi'u thung ste/ /rnam pa sna tshogs gzugs mnga' ba/ /rdo rje dbyangs can mas zhus pa/ /bde ba chen po khyod gar mdzad/ /hrīḥṣ+t+rīḥ'i gsang sngags dag gis khyod/ /gnas gsum the tshom med par gyis/ /snying rje'i khro bo rje btsun khyod/ /'gro ba kun gyis gar mdzad mthong*/ /zhes bya ba dang*/ me tog phreng dang spos dang dri/ /mar me zhal zas la sogs dang*/ /gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro/ /reg bya dag ste 'dod yon lnga/ /gzhan yang mchod pa'i rnam pa ni/ / rin chen ri dang dpag bsam shing*/ /bla re rgyal mtshan 'phan gdugs kyis/ / phyogs bcu nam mkha'i khams bkang nas / /bla ma rdzogs sangs rgyas la dbul// 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol / /zhes brjod do/ /de nas bla na med pa'i mchod pa ni/ lha mo de rnams kyis zag pa med pa'i bde bas mchod par bsam zhing | gzugs sgra la sogs drug po 'di/ /dngos med nam mkha' lta bu la/ / longs spyod yul du du mar snang*/ /shel la tshon ni ji bzhin no/ /'dod pa lnga dang chos rnams la/ /rnal 'byor rtag tu spyod par shog /a la la ho rol du gsol// gnas par mdzod/ mi 'dzin sgyu ma lta bu la/ /gar gyis dgyes shing rol par mdzod | | reg bya 'gag pa med pa la/ /mi g.yo bzhin du rol par mdzod/

/ ho chags med pas chags par mdzod/ /ces brjod nas/ pū dza badz+ra'i sngags kyi byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas lha mo de dag nyid kyis bstod par bsam zhing*/ gti mug rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /gshin rje'i dgra dga' 'jigs pa po/ / ston pa sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag /mgon po 'jigs med phyag 'tshal bstod// ser sna rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /gshin rje'i dgra dga' 'jigs pa po/ / thugs kyi rdo rje'i rang snang ba/ /rin chen rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'dod chags rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /mnga' bdag 'dod chags chos 'byung ba/ / dbyangs kun gyi ni mchog gi mchog /rdo rje gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phrag dog rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /gshin rje'i dgra ste las kun mdzad/ /sku yi rdo rje rab snang ba/ /ral gri'i phyag la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin khyod/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni kun sdud pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mchog gi mchog /dkyil 'khor bdag por phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces brjod nas | stu ti badz+ra'i sngags kyi byin gyis brlab bo/ /mdun bskyed mchod pa'i rim pa'o/ /rgyun bshags byed par 'dod na/ phyag 'tshal zhing tsog pur 'dug nas | thog mar rgyun bshags dang*/ de nas sdom pa gzung bar bya'o/ /de nas gtor ma rnams sbyangs nas/ dang po gong du bstan pa'i cho gas gshin rje gshed la dbul/ gnyis pa rang gi chos skyong la dbul/ /gsum pa mkha' 'gro spyi'i gtor mas 'byung po kun la dbul lo/ /gtor ma'i cho ga'o/ /de nas tshogs kyi yo byad rnams mngon du byas nas/ gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ yo byad rnams mngon du bteg pa'am/ yang na bteg par bsams la/ bdag bskyed dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi lha rnams la thun mong du bstabs par bsam zhing | gzugs sgra la sogs drug po 'di/ /la sogs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa lan gsum brjod do/ /de nas phud lha dang gtor ma la dbul zhing*/

dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams la dam tshig drang ba nas bzung nas/ lhag ma'i cho ga dang | rdo rje'i glu dang*/ bkra shis kyi bar gzhan dang 'dra bar bya'o/ /mngon par 'dod pa'i don gsol ba gdab bo/ /de nas yi ge brgya pas lhag chad bskangs la | rdo rje thal mo snying gar sbyar nas smon lam gdab par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med par/ /gang gi lam gyis grol 'gyur ba/ /des ni sangs rgyas nyid thob shog /bgegs dang log par 'dren pa rnams/ /gdul dka' 'dul byed dpa' bo ni/ /shin tu gtum pa'i khro gzugs kyis/ /ma lus pa rnams tshar gcod shog /ces bya ba dang*/ gzhan yang ci shes pa'i smon lam gdab bo/ /de nas mdun bskyed kyi lha la bzod par gsol bar bsam zhing*/ gang yang bdag blo gti mug pas/ / legs spyad 'di la nyes pa gang*/ /gang phyir lus can skyabs gyur pa/ /de dag thams cad bzod par mdzod/ /ces bzod par gsol nas/ mgon dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /'jig rten skyong ba'i lha rnams kyis/ /theg pa che las mi nyams shing*/ /slar yang bdag la phan mdzad par/ /nges par yang dag gyur nas ni/ /mgon po rigs dang sras bcas rnams/ /ci bde bar ni gshegs su gsol || zhes brjod pa'i mthar/ oṃ āḥmuḥzhes brjod la/ ye shes pa gshegs su gsol lo/ /dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu'o/ /ras bris la sogs pa'i rten yod na 'das pa'i lha gshegs su mi gsol bar/ 'jig rten pa'i lha dang gtor ma'i mgron gshegs su gsol lo/ /de nas rang gi gnas gsum bsrungs la/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bsdus nas ci bde bar spyad do/ / tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs shing bar chad zhi ba dang*/ 'dod pa'i don thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /mchod pa'i rim pa'o/ /rnal 'byor pa lam gyi rim pa 'di la rtag tu gnas na myur du gshin rje gshed kyi go 'phang thob cing*/ gnas skabs su bgegs dang bar du gcod pa thams cad las rgyal bar 'gyur ba dang*/

thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad tshegs med par 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /chos kyi tshul 'di ni/ bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa gnyis las 'ongs pa ste | de'ang*/ 'jam dpal sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs dang ni/ /mar me mdzad dpal bzang po bzang po'i zhabs/ /dzā ma ri pa rnal 'byor nā ro pa/ /mi mnyam rdo rje'i khol dang ye rang ba/ /blo gros grags dang sa skyar bzhugs pa yi/ /bla ma rnams las rim bzhin brgyud pa'o/ /brgyud pa gnyis pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang chen ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /ti lo pa dang nā ro ta pa ba/ /shes rab bsrungs pa mañja gling pa dang*/ /rdo rje grags pa rje btsun chos rab dang*/ /ye shes seng ge bla ma 'bum seng dang*/ /klog skya dbang phyug grags par grags pa dang*/ /mang du gsan pa'i dbyig gis phyug gyur cing*/ /rnam par dpyod pa'i blo gros mtshungs med pa/ /mkhyen rab dam pa'i dpal zhes bya ba yi/ /bla ma mchog las brgyud de 'ongs pa'o/ /ma lus rgyal ba'i mkhyen rab gcig bsdus pa/ /bcom ldan mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid ni/ khro bor gyur pa gshin rje gshed mchog

gi | sgrub pa'i thabs kyi rim pa gsal ba 'di/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir zhugs 'dun pa'i yid ldan pa/ /dbang ldan dpal zhes bya bas gsol btab nas/ / 'jam dpal zhi khro'i rgyud sde rab 'dzin pa/ /'phags pa zhes byas gsal bar sbyar ba yin/ /de las dge ba'i rtsa ba gang bskrun pa/ /de yis 'gro kun gshin rje gshed mchog gi /stobs kyis mi mthun phyogs las nyer rgyal nas/ /'jam pa'i dpal gyi dpal gyis 'byor par shog /gshin rje'i dgra nag po'i sgrub pa'i thabs 'di ni/ lcags mo bya'i lo khra'i zla ba tshes brgyad kyi nyin par rgyal po'i pho brang du rdzogs par sbyar ba'o// // ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi mngon rtogs bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi mngon par rtogs pa zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje'i mthus/ /'jigs byed 'jigs par byed pa po/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed la btud de/ /de yi sgrub pa'i rim pa bshad/ /'di yi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pas 'di nyams su len par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ stan bde ba la ci bde bar kha lho phyogs su bltas te 'dug la | skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ sems bskyed pa sngon du song nas skad cig gis rang phyag gnyis par dmigs pa'i thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pa can gyis dbur brgyan pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs la/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥdang na ma shrī badz+ra bhai ra wa maṇ+ḍa le bh+yaḥs bla ma dang lha la phyag 'tshal nas/ oṃ badz+ra la s+ye hūm̐ gis sgeg mo dkar mo/ oṃ badz+ra mā le trām̐ gis phreng ba ma ser mo/ oṃ badz+ra gī tī hrīḥs glu ma dmar mo/ oṃ badz+ra nirtī āḥs gar ma ljang gu dang*/

yang oṃ badz+ra nghū pe hūm̐ gis bdug spos ma dkar mo/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe trāṃ gis me tog ma ser mo/ ∶ oṃ badz+ra dī pe (《 lu 》 a lo ke ) hrīḥs mar me ma dmar mo/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥs dri ma ljang gu rnams rang gi snying ga nas spros la re re la'ang dpag tu med par gyur pas/ tshogs kyi zhing mchod nas/ dpal chen po'i thugs kar thim par bsam mo/ /de nas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes pa la sogs pa yan lag bdun pa lan gsum dang*/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ /la sogs pas sdom pa gzung ba lan gsum byas nas/ byams pa dang*/ snying rje dang | dga' ba dang*/ btang snyoms te tshad med pa bzhi bsgom pa ni bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'o/ /de nas oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ | zhes bdag gzhan thams cad mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du bsgom pa ni ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa'o/ /de nas stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad ∶ par (《 zha 》 pa'i steng du ) sngon gyi smon lam gyi mthus ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las phyogs kun tu 'od zer 'phros pa las sra zhing brtan pa mi phyed cing rgya che ba/ rdo rje'i gzhi ra ba dra ba gur bla re phyi rol du bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me ri 'bar bas (《 zha 》《 lu 》+ yongs su ) bskor ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgoms nas/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du e las chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag yangs shing rgya che ba 'bar bas bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi nang du/ yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor ljang sngon sra zhing brtan pa'i gzhi la khrag zhag 'khrugs pa'i rgya mtsho chen po'i klong dkyil du/ mi mgo skam po'i ra ba zlum po sgo gcig dang ldan pa'i steng keng rus kyis phub pa/

g.yang bzhi'i bla re dang*/ rgyu rlon gyi lda ldi dang*/ rus pa'i phreng ba la sogs pas brgyan pa'i gzhal med khang gi phyi rol du ji skad bshad pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi dur khrod chen po brgyad phyogs skyong ba dang*/ zhing skyong ba dang | shing dang*/ sprin dang*/ me dang*/ chu dang*/ mchod rten dang*/ klu dang bcas shing grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma dang*/ 'dre dang*/ srin po dang | mkha' 'gro dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ ro dang*/ ro langs dang*/ sha za dang | 'byung pos (《 zha 》《 lu 》+ 'i tshogs kyis ) yongs su gang bas bskor ba'i nang du | pam̐ las pad+ma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rang gi shes pa yi ge dhīḥnyi ma'i mdog can du dmigs pa las | tshad med pa'i 'od zer 'phros pas gzhal du med pa'i sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus te yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid 'jam dbyangs su gyur pa ni/ gser btso ma'i mdog can zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ bsgyings pa dang bcas pa'i rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing*/ g.yas pa'i phyag gis rab tu 'bar ba'i ral gri/ g.yon pas ut+pal la gnas pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i pu sti 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i zur phud lnga dang ldan zhing rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs pa'i na bzas klubs shing 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba/ zhi ba dang sgeg pa dang 'dzum pa'i nyams dang ldan par lta'o/ /de'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du/ hūm̐ bsams pa las phyogs bcur 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phog pas de rnams kyi thugs ka nas gshin rje gshed kyi khro bo dpag tu med pa spyan drangs pa bdag la thim zhing yongs su gyur pa las 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i 'od kyi phung po chen por gyur/ de las yang 'od zer 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs ka nas ā li dang kā li dang rtsa sngags dang*/

snying po dang*/ nye ba'i snying po rnams/ rang rang gi sgra 'brug gi dbyangs ltar sgrogs bzhin pa dpag tu med pa bkug la thim pas/ hūm̐ gi yi ge mthing ga chen po zhig tu gyur/ de las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs ka nas/ rdo rje dang gri gug dang thod pa la sogs pa phyag mtshan dpag tu med pa bkug la thim pas/ rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa shin tu gdengs pa lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa zhig tu gyur/ de las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas nam mkha'i khams kyis gtugs pa'i snod thams cad gzhal yas khang dang*/ bcud thams cad gshin rje gshed kyi khro bo'i tshogs su byas nas slar 'dus shing (《 zha 》《 lu 》+ thim nas ) yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje 'jigs byed du gyur pa ni/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/ /gcig tu bsdus pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ / thugs rjes gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyir/ khro bor gyur pa gshin rje gshed/ /zhal dgu sum cu rtsa bzhi'i phyag /bcu drug zhabs kyi g.yas rnams bskum/ /g.yon brkyang rnam par bsgyings pas bzhugs/ /rtsa zhal ma he khros pa'i gdong*/ /hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyi sgra sgrogs pa/ /steng zhal dmar po rgya cher bzhad/ /de steng 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i zhal/ /gser gyi mdog can shin tu 'dzum/ /g.yas pa'i rwa yi phyogs kyi zhal/ /dang po sngon po mche ba gtsigs/ /gnyis pa dmar po ljags 'dril zhing*/ /gsum pa ser po khro gnyer can/ /g.yon pa'i rwa yi phyogs kyi zhal/ /dang po dkar pos rmongs par byed/ /gnyis pa dud khas rengs par byed/ /gsum pa nag pos gsod par byed/ khro zhal thams cad spyan gsum ldan/ /g.yas pa'i phyag rnams rim pa bzhin/ /gri gug 'phang mdung gtun shing dang*/ /chu gri rdo rje rtse gcig pa/ /dgra sta mdung mda' lcags kyu dang*/ /dbyug pa kha ṭ+wāṃ 'khor lo dang*/

/rdo rje rtse lnga tho ba dang*/ /ral gri rnge'u chung rim bzhin 'dzin/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis rim bzhin du/ khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa dang*/ /mgo phub rkang pa zhags pa gzhu/ /rgyu ma dril bu lag pa dang | | ro ras skyes bu gsal shing phug /me thab thod tshal sdigs mdzub dang*// 'phan rtse gsum pa rlung ras 'dzin/ /tha ma yi ni phyag gnyis kyis/ /glang chen ko rlon gos su gyon/ /zhabs g.yas rnams kyis rim bzhin du/ /mi dang ma he glang bong bu/ /rnga mo khyi lug ce spyang mnan/ /g.yon rnams rim bzhin bya rgod dang | | 'ug pa khwa dang bya rog dang*/ /ne tso khyung chen ri skegs bzhad/ /mnan zhing zhabs rnams thams cad kyis/ /tshangs pa dbang po nye dbang dang*/ /drag po gzhon nu gdong drug rnams/ /bsgyel nas kha sbub nyid du mnan/ /mi mgo skam po lnga lnga yis/ khro zhal rnams kyi dbu la brgyan/ /mi mgo khrag 'dzag lnga bcu dang | | sbrul nag chun pos do shal byas/ /dbu skra ser po gyen du 'bar/ /spyan rtsa dmar po glog ltar 'khyug /rus rgyan drug gis sku la brgyan/ /thal chen mchog gi tshom bu dang*/ khrag zhag dmar po'i thig le dang*/ /zhag chen zo ris rnams kyis mtshan/ /lid+ga dmar po gyen du langs/ /sku las sprul pa'i pho nya 'phro | | sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ /dgod pa drag shul 'jigs su rung*/ / snying rje rngam dang zhi ba yi/ /gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa yis/ /ye shes me dpung dbus na bzhugs/ /de ltar gsal bar dmigs pa'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po bkod nas/ mig byang chub sems dpa' sa'i snying po/ rna ba phyag na rdo rje/ sna nam mkha'i snying po/ lce 'jig rten dbang phyug lus sgrib pa rnam sel/ yid kun tu bzang po/ zhes lhag par mos nas/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje 'jigs byed la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang khro bo dang khro mo'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs par bsam zhing*/

rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ e h+ye hi bha ga wān badz+ra bhe ra wa (《 lu 》+ ya ) sa pa ri wā ra sa mā (《 lu 》+ ya ) dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes brjod pas mdun du byon pa la snga ma ltar mchod nas/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams/ /thugs rje'i rang bzhin can rnams kyi/ khyed kyis bdag la dbang bskur stsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pas spyi bo nas dbang bskur zhing | sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi | khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ / rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ / om̐ badz+ra u da ka a bhi ṣiñca su ra ti sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo dang khro mo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ thams cad kyis khro bo'i phyag mtshan dang*/ chos rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i chu rgyun gyis rkang mthil yan chad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag dbang bzhi thob/ khyad par du khro bo'i mthu stobs dang*/ phrin las (《 lu 》+ thams cad ) la dbang bar byas/ chu lhag ma yar lud pas/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par bsam mo/ /de nas rang gi snying ga nas rdo rje lcags kyu'i tshogs spros nas/ dbang gi lha de nyid ye shes pa'i tshul du bkug par bsam zhing | oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ zhes brjod/ rdo rje zhags pa'i tshogs spros pas/ bdag la nye bar byon par bsam zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ rdo rje lcags sgrog gi tshogs spros pas bdag la bstim par bsam zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra s+phau ṭa bam̐/ zhes brjod/ de dag thams cad mnyes bzhin bzhugs par bsam zhing*/ ∶ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ (《 zha 》《 lu 》 oṃ badz+ra.ā we sha a ) zhes brjod do/ /de nas rang gi snying ga'i nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa rdo rje sems dpa' lta bu'i ye shes sems dpa' bsgom zhing*/

de'i thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' bsam par bya'o/ /de nas 'di'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcings la gnas gsum du gtug cing*/ hrīḥṣ+t+rī:re re brjod pas byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas mdun du bdud rtsi mngon par 'dus byas la/ gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs pa lce la myangs pas lus thams cad bdud rtsis gang nas bde ba chen po skyes par bsam zhing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod do/ /de nas rang gi thugs ka nas mchod rdzas du ma thogs pa'i lha mo dpag tu med pa spros pas bdag la mchod pa thams cad kyis mchod par bsam zhing*/ gzugs sgra la sogs drug po 'di/ /dngos med nam mkha' lta bu la | | longs spyod yul du du mar snang*/ /shel la tshon ni ji bzhin no/ /'dod pa lnga dang chos rnams la/ /rnal 'byor rtag tu spyod par shog /a la la ho rol du gsol/ /gnas par mdzod/ mi 'dzin sgyu ma lta bu la/ /dgyes pa'i gar gyis rol par mdzod*/ /reg bya 'gags pa med pa la/ /mi g.yo bzhin du rol par mdzod/ /ho chags pa med bzhin chags par mdzod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ∶ pū dza (《 zha 》 rū pa ) badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod do/ /de nas lha mo de dag nyid kyis bdag la bstod par bsam zhing*/ /dur khrod rgyan gyis legs brgyan pa'i/ /zhe sdang gshin rje gshed po ni/ /dngos med nam mkha' lta bu la// thugs rjes sprul pa'i skur ston pa'i/ /ye shes khro rgyal rab 'jigs pa/ /dud kha mun chen khyod la bstod/ /ces brjod nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu sti badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pas brtan par bya'o/ /de nas lha mo de dag rang gi thugs kar bsdus nas/ ji ltar bsgoms pa'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo snang la rang bzhin med pa/

dbang po'i gzhu 'dra ba la yid gtad de sems rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag par bya'o/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa'o/ /de nas rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom par 'dod pas/ kye'i rdo rje las 'byung ba'i rim pa ltar bsgom pa nyid do/ /gang gi tshe sngags zlo bar 'dod pa de'i tshe/ ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i nang gi khor yug tu nye snying dang*/ bar gyi khor yug tu snying po dang*/ phyi'i khor yug tu rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bskor ba/ gnyis ka'i lus la sangs rgyas lnga'i ngo bo (《 zha 》《 lu 》+ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā ces pas ) g.yas phyogs su 'khor ba'i 'od zer sna tshogs 'phros pas bdag dang bsgrub bya'i chos rgyal 'phags pa'i gsung rab dpe bsdur ma pod gsum pa/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ sa skya bka' 'bum/ PAGE 18PAGE 19
